title: 表单状态管理
html:
表单状态管理

核心概念

表单是 Web 应用中最常见的用户交互方式，表单状态管理涉及输入值、验证、错误处理、提交状态等多个方面。

graph TD
    A[表单状态] --> B[输入值]
    A --> C[验证状态]
    A --> D[错误信息]
    A --> E[提交状态]
    B --> F[受控/非受控]
    C --> G[实时/提交时]
    D --> H[字段级/表单级]
    E --> I[loading/success/error]

表单状态的特点

  • 高频更新：用户输入时状态频繁变化
  • 验证需求：实时或提交时验证
  • 复杂逻辑：字段依赖、条件验证
  • 异步操作：远程验证、API 提交

表单状态管理方案对比

方案 适用场景 复杂度 学习曲线
React useState 简单表单 低 低
React useReducer 中等复杂度 中 低
React Hook Form 高性能表单 低 中
Formik 功能丰富 中 中

基础表单实现

使用 useState 管理简单表单

import { useState } from 'react'

interface LoginFormData {
  email: string
  password: string
}

function LoginForm() {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<LoginFormData>({
    email: '',
    password: ''
  })
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Partial<LoginFormData>>({})
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [isSubmitted, setIsSubmitted] = useState(false)

  const validate = () => {
    const newErrors: Partial<LoginFormData> = {}

    if (!formData.email) {
      newErrors.email = 'Email is required'
    } else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(formData.email)) {
      newErrors.email = 'Invalid email format'
    }

    if (!formData.password) {
      newErrors.password = 'Password is required'
    } else if (formData.password.length < 8) {
      newErrors.password = 'Password must be at least 8 characters'
    }

    setErrors(newErrors)
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0
  }

  const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }))
    if (errors[name as keyof LoginFormData]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: undefined }))
    }
  }

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()

    if (!validate()) {
      return
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true)

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/login', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(formData)
      })

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('Login failed')
      }

      setIsSubmitted(true)
    } catch (error) {
      setErrors({ email: 'Login failed. Please try again.' })
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false)
    }
  }

  if (isSubmitted) {
    return (
      <div>
        <h2>Login successful!</h2>
        <button onClick={() => {
          setFormData({ email: '', password: '' })
          setErrors({})
          setIsSubmitted(false)
        }}>
          Go back
        </button>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      <div>
        <label htmlFor="email">Email</label>
        <input
          type="email"
          id="email"
          name="email"
          value={formData.email}
          onChange={handleChange}
          disabled={isSubmitting}
        />
        {errors.email && <p>{errors.email}</p>}
      </div>
      <div>
        <label htmlFor="password">Password</label>
        <input
          type="password"
          id="password"
          name="password"
          value={formData.password}
          onChange={handleChange}
          disabled={isSubmitting}
        />
        {errors.password && <p>{errors.password}</p>}
      </div>
      <button type="submit" disabled={isSubmitting}>
        {isSubmitting ? 'Logging in...' : 'Login'}
      </button>
    </form>
  )
}

受控组件 vs 非受控组件

受控组件

import { useState } from 'react'

function ControlledInput() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState('')

  return (
    <input
      type="text"
      value={value}
      onChange={e => setValue(e.target.value)}
    />
  )
}

非受控组件

import { useRef } from 'react'

function UncontrolledInput() {
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    const value = inputRef.current?.value
    console.log(value)
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      <input type="text" ref={inputRef} />
      <button type="submit">Submit</button>
    </form>
  )
}

对比

特性 受控组件 非受控组件
状态管理 React 状态 DOM
实时验证 容易 较难
条件渲染 容易 较难
性能 可能较低 较高
表单重置 需要手动 原生支持

React Hook Form

基础用法

import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form'

interface LoginFormData {
  email: string
  password: string
}

function LoginForm() {
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitting, isSubmitted }
  } = useForm<LoginFormData>({
    defaultValues: {
      email: '',
      password: ''
    }
  })

  const onSubmit = async (data: LoginFormData) => {
    await fetch('/api/login', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify(data)
    })
  }

  if (isSubmitted) {
    return <h2>Success!</h2>
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}>
      <div>
        <label>Email</label>
        <input
          type="email"
          {...register('email', {
            required: 'Email is required',
            pattern: {
              value: /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/,
              message: 'Invalid email format'
            }
          })}
          disabled={isSubmitting}
        />
        {errors.email && <p>{errors.email.message}</p>}
      </div>
      <div>
        <label>Password</label>
        <input
          type="password"
          {...register('password', {
            required: 'Password is required',
            minLength: {
              value: 8,
              message: 'Password must be at least 8 characters'
            }
          })}
          disabled={isSubmitting}
        />
        {errors.password && <p>{errors.password.message}</p>}
      </div>
      <button type="submit" disabled={isSubmitting}>
        {isSubmitting ? 'Loading...' : 'Submit'}
      </button>
    </form>
  )
}

嵌套表单

import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form'

interface Address {
  street: string
  city: string
  zipCode: string
}

interface UserFormData {
  name: string
  email: string
  address: Address
}

function UserForm() {
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors }
  } = useForm<UserFormData>()

  const onSubmit = (data: UserFormData) => {
    console.log(data)
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}>
      <div>
        <label>Name</label>
        <input {...register('name', { required: true })} />
      </div>
      <div>
        <label>Email</label>
        <input type="email" {...register('email', { required: true })} />
      </div>
      <fieldset>
        <legend>Address</legend>
        <div>
          <label>Street</label>
          <input {...register('address.street', { required: true })} />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label>City</label>
          <input {...register('address.city', { required: true })} />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label>Zip Code</label>
          <input {...register('address.zipCode', { required: true })} />
        </div>
      </fieldset>
      <button type="submit">Submit</button>
    </form>
  )
}

复杂表单模式

动态字段

import { useState } from 'react'

interface DynamicFormData {
  emails: string[]
}

function DynamicForm() {
  const [emails, setEmails] = useState<string[]>([''])

  const addEmail = () => {
    setEmails(prev => [...prev, ''])
  }

  const removeEmail = (index: number) => {
    setEmails(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index))
  }

  const updateEmail = (index: number, value: string) => {
    setEmails(prev => prev.map((email, i) => i === index ? value : email))
  }

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    console.log(emails.filter(email => email))
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      {emails.map((email, index) => (
        <div key={index}>
          <input
            type="email"
            value={email}
            onChange={e => updateEmail(index, e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Email"
          />
          {emails.length > 1 && (
            <button type="button" onClick={() => removeEmail(index)}>
              Remove
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      ))}
      <button type="button" onClick={addEmail}>
        Add Email
      </button>
      <button type="submit">Submit</button>
    </form>
  )
}

条件字段

import { useState } from 'react'

interface CheckoutFormData {
  paymentMethod: 'credit-card' | 'paypal'
  cardNumber?: string
  paypalEmail?: string
}

function CheckoutForm() {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CheckoutFormData>({
    paymentMethod: 'credit-card'
  })

  const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }))
  }

  return (
    <form>
      <div>
        <label>Payment Method</label>
        <select
          name="paymentMethod"
          value={formData.paymentMethod}
          onChange={handleChange}
        >
          <option value="credit-card">Credit Card</option>
          <option value="paypal">PayPal</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      {formData.paymentMethod === 'credit-card' && (
        <div>
          <label>Card Number</label>
          <input
            type="text"
            name="cardNumber"
            value={formData.cardNumber || ''}
            onChange={handleChange}
          />
        </div>
      )}
      {formData.paymentMethod === 'paypal' && (
        <div>
          <label>PayPal Email</label>
          <input
            type="email"
            name="paypalEmail"
            value={formData.paypalEmail || ''}
            onChange={handleChange}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </form>
  )
}

常见误区

❌ 误区 1：过度重新渲染

// ❌ 不好的做法：每个输入都导致整个表单重新渲染
// 考虑使用 React Hook Form 或非受控组件

❌ 误区 2：忽略可访问性

// ✅ 好的做法：使用 label 和 htmlFor
<label htmlFor="email">Email</label>
<input id="email" type="email" />

❌ 误区 3：验证时机不当

// ✅ 好的做法：模糊时验证，输入时清除错误
const handleBlur = () => validate();
const handleChange = () => clearError();

小结

mindmap
  root((表单状态管理))
    受控组件
      精确控制
      实时验证
      性能开销
    非受控组件
      DOM 驱动
      简单高效
      ref 读取
    React Hook Form
      非受控为主
      高性能
      Zod 验证
    Formik
      受控为主
      功能全面
      社区成熟
    验证策略
      实时验证
      失焦验证
      提交时验证
  • 表单状态管理需要权衡复杂度和性能
  • 简单表单用受控组件，复杂表单用 React Hook Form
  • 使用 Zod 做类型安全的验证

核心要点回顾：

  • 简单表单用 useState
  • 复杂表单考虑 React Hook Form
  • 受控组件提供更好的控制
  • 非受控组件性能更好
  • 验证要考虑时机和用户体验
  • 不要忽略可访问性
